title: A late bus home
paragraphs: Maya usually caught the five o’clock bus, but on Tuesday she stayed late to finish a poster. By the time she reached the stop, the road was {{1}}. A notice said that the last bus had already {{2}}.

She called her aunt, who lived nearby. While she waited, she noticed an old man who seemed {{3}}. He asked for {{4}} to the clinic, so she showed him the way on her phone. When her aunt arrived, Maya waved {{5}} and got into the car.
